impact_scope.description: The existing public restart_frame! lifecycle method now also resets the decoder's internal expect_multiple_scans flag; its signature, arguments, and call-order entry requirements are unchanged.

evidence: H0 initializes the JPEG decoder and uses fuzz_image_decoder for ordinary image/frame decoding, but never calls restart_frame!.
S1 retains the same decoder.restart_frame!(index, io_position) public callable and adds only the internal assignment expect_multiple_scans = false.
Unchanged H0 still never calls restart_frame!; no new caller-supplied argument, configuration, or call-order transition is required to obtain the added reset when the method is called.

new_harness_obligation.description: The added state reset occurs automatically inside an existing lifecycle method and does not change how H0 would reach or control that method.
evidence: restart_frame!'s public signature and preconditions are unchanged between S0 and S1.
The new expect_multiple_scans value is internal and is not supplied or configured by the harness.

reason: For the anchored existing public lifecycle callable, H0 omits the restart_frame! path in both states. The S1 internal reset adds behavior but no caller-visible harness action, so the same-scope exposure gap remains true before and after.
